title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Starz and Zillas
One alleged gang leader is charged with assault shortly after his arrest and now his arch-rival has been booked into the jail as well; an admitted identity thief and meth addict clings to hope for a better life.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S4 E6 — Word to the Wise
Using inmates to turn troubled teens away from a life of crime; inmates express their regrets.

title: Lockup Special Investigation
description:
S1 E3 — Lake County Juvenile Justice: Kevin, Kymyada
Juvenile Court Judge Mary Beth Bonaventura observes that an indicator of what will happen in a child's life can be found by looking at the family and how supportive it has been; the kids seem to know this, too.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure
The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.

title: Lockup: Tampa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Mother Knows Best?
A convict finds that jail offers a chance for revenge, a former stripper fears losing her daughter, and you'll get a "taste" of Tampa behind bars.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — The Eyes Have It
Just weeks away from completing his sentence, an inmate is accused of murdering his cellie; a large woman with a personality to match loses everything to meth; an inmate causes a disturbance on the jail's transfer bus.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Message in a Bottle
A jailhouse assault leads to one bloody inmate, and two sides to the story; another inmate makes a daring escape; one of the jail's most violent inmates decides it's time for a change.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Homecoming
Extractions provide some of the most dramatic interactions that ever occur between inmates and staff, and few extractions in the state of Colorado have provided more drama than the ones involving Roy Slagle.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E85 — Make Me Rich or Die; Kids for Cash
A man threatens investment professionals to make him rich; two judges get rich off of a secret deal to build juvenile detention centers.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E19 — Lesson in Greed; Soldier Scam
A school supply vendor steals millions from Detroit public schools by enlisting shady school officials; crooks use photos of real military men to lure women into sending them love and money.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E2 — Deadly Opioids, Dirty Doctors
Two doctors run their Alabama pain clinics like heartless pill mills-illegally prescribing opioids while destroying lives and pocketing millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E4 — The Polka King Con
Polka band leader Jan Lewan rips off his adoring fans with false promises of sizable investment returns.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E10 — Florida Rehab Gone Wild
Kenny Chatman runs a string of corrupt drug rehab facilities in South Florida stealing millions by keeping insured addicts hooked on drugs; his plans include turning patients into prostitutes and sober homes into drug-fueled brothels.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E3 — Fool's Gold
Philanthropist, diplomat, international man of mystery, and criminal Dr Henry Jones led a double-life that was unknown to all he knew.

title: American Greed
description:
S9 E4 — A Widow's Web
After golf, millionaire Gary Triano puts the keys into the ignition and is killed instantly by a car bomb, uncovering a bizarre murder-for-hire plot hatched by his ex-wife and her lover that's revealed in a series of recorded conversations.

title: American Greed
description:

A charismatic New Mexico real estate broker scams $75 million in a fake land investment program.
